SOURCE: CanaRetail practice case (fictional teaching case, Module D solution of CyberRiskGuardian Desktop) - cross-engine regression fixture: total estimated 27,526 / residual 16,049 at appetite 0.50

SCEN.name: Ransomware encrypting central servers, SAP and store back-end systems, with data theft
SCEN.cvss_note: Representative weakness: malicious document leading to code execution (initial vector). AV:L: delivered by e-mail but opened locally (FIRST CVSS v4.0 user guide); AC:L; AT:N; PR:N; UI:P the user opens the document; VC/VI/VA:H on the workstation; SC/SI/SA:H because SAP and the data centre are subsequently affected. CVSS describes the entry weakness only, not the enterprise impact.

SCEN.name: Malicious IT insider exfiltrates customer, supplier and proprietary data
SCEN.cvss_note: Scored by equivalency (people and process weakness: standing privileges without monitoring). AV:N remote access to the systems; AC:L; AT:N; PR:H administrator rights needed; UI:N; VC:H on SAP data; VI:L possible track covering; VA:N; SC:H customer and supplier data downstream; SI:N; SA:N. Limited applicability.

SCEN.name: POS memory-scraping malware steals card data across stores
SCEN.cvss_note: Representative weakness: remote-support access to POS through a shared account without MFA (CWE-1390 weak authentication). AV:N; AC:L; AT:P the vendor credential must be obtained first; PR:N; UI:N; VC/VI:H on the terminal; VA:L; SC:H card data of customers downstream; SI:L; SA:N.

SCEN.name: Exploitation of an unpatched internet-facing VPN appliance
SCEN.cvss_note: Representative weakness: unauthenticated remote code execution in a VPN appliance (CWE-787 class). AV:N; AC:L; AT:N; PR:N; UI:N; VC/VI/VA:H on the appliance; SC/SI/SA:H on the internal network behind it. Exploitation evidence (KEV, EPSS) goes to Pb(ψ,A), not to CVSS.

SCEN.name: Unsecured cloud storage bucket exposes customer information
SCEN.cvss_note: Representative weakness: publicly readable storage (CWE-732 incorrect permission assignment). AV:N; AC:L; AT:N; PR:N; UI:N; VC:H; no integrity or availability effect; no subsequent-system effect.

SCEN.name: Weak encryption and key management allow decryption of stored customer data
SCEN.cvss_note: Representative weakness: broken or risky cryptographic algorithm with keys stored alongside the data (CWE-327, CWE-321). AV:N; AC:H the attacker must defeat the encryption; AT:P a data copy must first be obtained; PR:L; UI:N; VC:H; no integrity, availability or subsequent effect scored.

SCEN.name: SQL injection on the e-commerce website exposes back-end customer data
SCEN.cvss_note: Representative weakness: SQL injection (CWE-89). AV:N; AC:L; AT:N; PR:N; UI:N; VC:H and VI:H on the database; VA:L; no subsequent-system effect scored (the skimmer harms customers’ data handled by the same system).

SCEN.name: Firewall misconfiguration exposes internal management services to the internet
SCEN.cvss_note: Representative weakness: management service exposed to the internet with weak authentication (CWE-284, CWE-307). AV:N; AC:L; AT:N; PR:N; UI:N; VC/VI/VA:H on the server; SC/SI/SA:L on connected systems.

SCEN.name: DNS hijacking redirects customers to malicious look-alike sites
SCEN.cvss_note: Scored by equivalency (third-party and configuration weakness: registrar account without MFA or lock). AV:N; AC:L; AT:P a credential must be phished; PR:N; UI:A the account holder must act on the lure; VC:L; VI/VA:H on the DNS zone; SC/SI:H customers’ data and the site they see; SA:L. Limited applicability.

SCEN.name: Over-privileged integration service account abused for bulk extraction of loyalty and order data
SCEN.cvss_note: Scored by equivalency (configuration and governance weakness of a machine identity). AV:N; AC:L; AT:P the secret must first be stolen; PR:L the service account’s own rights; UI:N; VC:H; VI:L; VA:N; SC:H customer data downstream; SI:L; SA:N. Limited applicability.
